package.name: rover_hw_bridge
package.description: Jetson-to-microcontroller bridge and a software-in-the-loop MCU (STM32 / ODrive) emulator. The Jetson issues velocity/heading commands over a framed serial/CAN protocol; the MCU runs the hard-real-time closed-loop motor control and watchdog. Includes reference STM32 firmware (firmware/stm32).
